title: Senior Magento Developer
description:

New roles for Senior Magento Engineers come in all the time, and several are open right now.

title: Looking For Online ESL Teachers - Remote- Joining Rewards of up to USD $100
description:
Polly English is an online English teaching company based in Singapore. We specialize in teaching English to students aged 3 to 18 across Asia, using interactive courseware inspired by Oxford Thinkers and delivered through our self-developed online classrooms. Our unique approach ensures high-interaction, high-quality classes designed to enhance students' English proficiency.

Why Join Polly English?

Our flagship offering is one-on-one online teaching, enabling us to provide customized courses tailored to each student's needs.

  • Compensation: $16–$24 per hour.

Application Process

To apply, simply follow this link: https://teach.pollyenglish.cn/website?ch_i=94f0a475a30e4c6e8d667e5793e09991

Once submitted, kindly notify us so we can expedite your application, considering your valuable teaching experience.

To welcome our new North American teachers, we're excited to offer exclusive New Teacher Rewards of up to USD $100 for teachers who join us and start teaching between August 14 and September 30.

🌟 Core Reward Rules

All rewards are subject to the following conditions:

  • Your first class must be completed by September 30.

  • No reward will be issued if the first class is not completed or is completed after the deadline.

  • No reward will be issued for class cancellations, no-shows/absences, or leaving the first class early.

💰 PPT Slot Rewards

Option 1 — Earn $50

  • Open 10 recurring PPT slots per week for 4 consecutive weeks after joining.

  • Complete your first class.

  • Have no no-shows.

  • 🎁 Reward: USD $50

Option 2 — Earn $100

  • Open 20 recurring PPT slots per week for 4 consecutive weeks after joining.

  • Complete at least 5 classes.

  • Have no no-shows.

  • 🎁 Reward: USD $100

⏳ Please complete your application within the next 2 days to meet the high demand for bookings.

Teacher Requirements

  • Native English speaker: USA, Canada.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher.

  • Certificates: Teaching or teacher qualification certificate issued by local authorities, plus an ESL certificate.

  • Experience: Over 1 year of teaching experience in local or international schools (including overseas international school experience).

Technical Requirements

  • Software: Polly English APP.

  • Hardware: Stable internet connection and Intel Core i5 (8th Gen or above). Ensure your device passes our compatibility test.

Availability

  • Peak Hours (Singapore Time):

    • Weekdays: 5:00 PM–9:00 PM.

    • Weekends: All day.

  • Minimum Teaching Hours: 10 hours during peak times.

Given your extensive teaching background, we believe Polly English would be an excellent fit for your skills and expertise. We look forward to the possibility of you joining our team and making a meaningful impact together.

If you have any questions or need additional information, please contact us at teacherrecruitment@pollyenglish.com. 

Why Now?

High Demand: Our marketing team is actively promoting classes, and newly onboarded teachers often receive bookings within 24 hours!

Limited-Time Bonus: Earn up to $50 by completing your application and opening peak-time slots (details below).

Fast-Track Approval: Apply early to maximize visibility during our upcoming promotional campaign.

 

To apply, simply follow this link: https://teach.pollyenglish.cn/website?ch_i=94f0a475a30e4c6e8d667e5793e09991

We’re here to assist you on your journey with Polly English.
